leadText: This is a list of themes that have been played in the n dub of the Pokémon animated series.
plainText:
This is a list of themes that have been played in the n dub of the Pokémon animated series.

==Openings==
The openings to Believe in Me, and were left undubbed. In Secrets of the Jungle, Always Safe was only shown with subtitles. The series Rubby and Sapphire, Black & White and XY, as well as season 13, were never aired, therefore their openings weren't dubbed.
